Job Summary

Supports the implementation and day-to-day operation of the Company’s Business Ethics and Integrity (BEI) function, particularly in relation to the Anti-Fraud and Anti-Bribery Management System (ABMS). The role supports monitoring of compliance with internal policies, procedures and applicable regulations and provides operational assistance in areas such as integrity monitoring, whistleblowing system administration, fact-finding investigations, and socialization activities. The Business Ethics and Integrity Specialist works under the supervision of BEI Manager and BEI Lead. The role also requires close coordination with internal stakeholders to support the promotion of a culture of integrity across the organization.

Job Responsibilities

Key
Metric

Support implementation and monitoring of Anti-Fraud and Anti-BriberyManagement System (ABMS).
Compliance with ABMSrequirements

Conduct integrity monitoring and assist in identifying fraud/bribery risks andanomalies.

Timely identification of riskfindings

Assist in fact-finding investigations and documentation of cases.

Quality and completeness ofinvestigation reports

Administer whistleblowing system and ensure proper case tracking.

Case response time & resolutiontracking

Maintain and actively implement SHE programs and responsibility (involve identify, mitigate and monitor SHE risk), including SHE Management System to ensure the effectiveness of the programs conform to official standard, requirements and procedure applied and to confirm the execution of the SHE Responsibility meet the intended outcome

• SHE risk well maintained
• Target Zero LTI
• SHE Management System meets the current ISO 14001, ISO 45001, SMK3 & SMKP standards and requirements

Education

Minimum Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.

Skill, Knowledge, and Experience

• Minimum 2–3 years of experience as an internal auditor, external auditor, ethics and compliance officer, anti-fraud officer, investigator, or in other relevant roles.
• Experiences in Anti-Fraud, ABMS, WBS-handling, fact-finding investigations, or similar areas.
• Capable of performing simple data analytics (e.g., MS Excel, SQL, PowerBI, or others) to process data to identify trends/anomalies.
• General knowledge and awareness of local and international anti-bribery and anti-corruption. regulations, including enforcement trends (e.g., UU Tipikor, UU TPPU, FCPA, and UK Bribery Act).
• Familiarity with business processes in the mining, oil and gas, and EPC sectors is an advantage.
• Experience in executing/handling socialization activities is an advantage.
• Ability to design flyer/communication materials is an advantage.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Good communication, presentation, public speaking, and report-writing skills.
• Proficiency in English, both written and verbal.
• Well-organized and detail-oriented.
• Demonstrates discipline and a strong commitment to ethical standards.

Certification

• Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) – preferred.
• ISO 37001 Lead Implementer/Lead Auditor – preferred
• Certified Compliance & Ethics Professional (CCEP) – advantageous.

Other Requirements

• Willing to travel as required, based on assignments

Chandra Asri Group is a leading chemical and infrastructure solutions company in Indonesia with a track record of over 31 years in the petrochemical industry. The company employs over 2,000 dedicated staff, incorporates state-of-the art technologies and supporting facilities located strategically in the country’s industrial hub, Cilegon and Serang. As a Growth Partner, Chandra Asri is committed on creating high-value jobs, expanding the domestic petrochemical value chain, and serving the needs of the vibrant and growing Indonesian market. Chandra Asri is currently expanding its portfolio in the energy sector and incorporating its asset as well as operational infrastructure to supports the expansion plan of the second world-scale integrated petrochemical complex in Indonesia, CAP2.
Job Descriptions

• Carry out all routine/non-routine maintenance work related to electrical Equipment, includes regular maintenance patrol, evaluate and take necessary action to fix any electrical problem or follow up problem found in the previous shift.
• Implement the electrical field activity to follow the work instruction and procedure correctly to increase productivity and keep production process smoothly. Check and identify electrical equipment problems to specify root cause to achieve equipment rectification correctly.
• Implement safe working practices and good housekeeping at the activity of Electrical Maintenance team in accordance the safety and health, environment and Quality Management systems.
• Conduct proper waste handling as an impact of those above activities to comply with relevant environmental law and regulation.
• Directly responsible with a shift contractor who assist him to perform his shift job.
• Perform clear written and oral communication among operation, other shift team and contractor during performing his job. Record and report immediately any abnormality to the related section/Department during his duty.

Qualifications

• Min Diploma 3 in Electrical Engineering
• Min 3 years of working experience in the same field
• Able to speak and write in English well
• Familiar with MS Office applications
• Proactive, self-motivated and team work oriented
• Willing to be placed in site office, Anyer - Banten

This position will be placed at site office Cilegon.

Chandra Asri is only releasing official job posting at Chandra Asri Career Site (careers.capcx.com), Linkedin & Jobstreet.
